name: move_speed_slider_mod
description: Adds a Walk Speed slider to the passive bonuses panel (Tab). Walking can be dialled up to your current sprint speed, never past it, so you can move at sprint pace without holding sprint (or keep auto-sprint and still have a fast walk).

config_schema.title: Config
config_schema.description: Config for Move Speed Slider Mod

walk_speed_bonus.title: Walk speed bonus
walk_speed_bonus.description: Extra walk speed as a fraction of base walk speed (0.5 = +50%). Set by the slider; walking never exceeds sprint speed.
